event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner)
event PoolCreated(address indexed stakingToken, address indexed rewardToken, uint256 rewardRate)
event PoolUpdated(address indexed stakingToken, uint256 newRewardRate)
event RewardsClaimed(address indexed user, address indexed rewardToken, uint256 amount)
event Staked(address indexed user, address indexed stakingToken, uint256 amount, uint256 tier)
event TierAdded(address indexed stakingToken, string tierName, uint256 rewardMultiplier)
event Unstaked(address indexed user, address indexed stakingToken, uint256 amount, uint256 penalty)
function addStakingTier(address stakingToken, string tierName, uint256 minStake, uint256 maxStake, uint256 rewardMultiplier, uint256 lockDuration, uint256 earlyWithdrawalPenalty) @1100000
function createPool(address stakingToken, address rewardToken, uint256 rewardRate, uint256 minStakeDuration, uint256 maxStakeDuration) @1100000
function getPendingRewards(address user, address stakingToken) view returns (uint256) @1100000

function getPool(address stakingToken) view returns (tuple(address stakingToken, address rewardToken, uint256 totalStaked, uint256 totalRewards, uint256 rewardRate, uint256 lastUpdateTime, uint256 rewardPerTokenStored, uint256 periodFinish, bool isActive, uint256 minStakeDuration, uint256 maxStakeDuration, uint256 earlyWithdrawalPenalty)) @1100000

function getStakingTiers(address stakingToken) view returns (tuple(string name, uint256 minStake, uint256 maxStake, uint256 rewardMultiplier, uint256 lockDuration, uint256 earlyWithdrawalPenalty)[]) @1100000

function getUserStake(address user, address stakingToken) view returns (tuple(uint256 amount, uint256 stakedAt, uint256 lastClaimTime, uint256 rewardDebt, uint256 pendingRewards, bool isActive)) @1100000
function stake(address stakingToken, uint256 amount, uint256 tierIndex) @1100000

function stakingPools(address) view returns (address stakingToken, address rewardToken, uint256 totalStaked, uint256 totalRewards, uint256 rewardRate, uint256 lastUpdateTime, uint256 rewardPerTokenStored, uint256 periodFinish, bool isActive, uint256 minStakeDuration, uint256 maxStakeDuration, uint256 earlyWithdrawalPenalty) @1100000
function stakingTiers(address, uint256) view returns (string name, uint256 minStake, uint256 maxStake, uint256 rewardMultiplier, uint256 lockDuration, uint256 earlyWithdrawalPenalty) @1100000
function userStakes(address, address) view returns (uint256 amount, uint256 stakedAt, uint256 lastClaimTime, uint256 rewardDebt, uint256 pendingRewards, bool isActive) @1100000
